en: So...what are you trying to\nsay?
I am telling you that this\nship was blasted over 200\nyears into the future!

I have worn out the
circuits checking the data
over and over again, but
the results are always the
same.

The current year is 772
(S.D.), and this is an
uncharted planet that the
federation has yet to
discover!

Data is everything to an
AI like me, so when my
calculations produce an
illogical result, an error
occurs! This is an error!

We have to find the cause
of the error first. We must
determine whether I am
broken, or if the fault is
somewhere else.

Somewhere else...? That
must mean the captain or
Eve? Everyone is broken.
First priority is to fix the
captain...
Coro! I know you're on the\nfritz, but hang in there!

Oh...when we fell through
that black hole, we must
have traveled through
space-time, or maybe into
a different dimension.

This planet actually is not
very far from Earth. The
problem is, there is no
way to be sure that it is
the "Earth" we know or
not...

I hate to say this, but it is
possible that we are in a
space-time where neither
the Earth nor the
federation exist.

No matter how far we
have to travel, we have to
find our way back to our
original timeline.
Huh!? Do you mean we\nneed to go back inside\nthat black hole!?

The idea terrifies me, but...
we may be able to return
to where we came from by
retracing our steps.
I see no other choice but\nto try the captain's plan.
There it is―the black hole!
Roger! Entering the black\nhole!
Eek! It's not just the ship\nit's swallowing─ it's all of\nspace-time itself!

Arrrgh! Something is
different this time. It is
not like the warp from
before...
Wha─!? Where are we...?

The scan is showing
nothing. I cannot tell
where we are, or even
which universe we are in!
Are we dead? Is this\nheaven or hell...?
...It's neither.
And now you disappear.\nThis is the end for you. No\nheaven, no hell.

You shall be destroyed,
just as you destroyed us,
the Executioners. It is time
to pay for your crimes.

Executioners...? You are
the ones the Captain and
Farleen wiped out in that
operation!
You talk too much, virus\nscum. I'll delete you first...
Eeek!!!
Stop that, Luther!
Another virus... Let's see.\nYou're Fayt Leingod, aren't\nyou?

The girl is Sophia...and
that other one must be
Maria. Hmph. I'll just have
to take you all on.
Just try it!
We'll...fight you!
All of you came here to\nend him too, right?
Let's join forces.
Who the heck are you\nguys?
Who is that man?
Thanks. The more the\nmerrier. We came here to\nfinish him, too.
...He's a powerful enemy.\nAre you sure you're\nready?
This is a fight we can't\nafford to lose! Please be\ncareful.
I'm sorry. There's no time\nfor explanations right now.
Either we defeat Luther,\nor all of us will be wiped\nout of existence!
Please believe us. We\nneed your strength.
Luther is the one who\ncreated our entire world,\nincluding us.

But he's no god. He's as
human as us. He
just...lives in a different
world.
He has no right to just\ndelete us from existence.

What are you silly viruses
talking about? Don't tell
me you're planning on
rebelling against me, your
Creator?
Viruses!? You may be the\none who made us, sure.
Even so, that doesn't give\nyou the right to decide\nour fates for us!
Bah... What do a bunch of\nzeroes and ones know\nabout rights...

Even if that were true, we
still have thoughts and
feelings. We still want to
save our world.
Silence! You're nothing but\ndata. Now stay still while I\ndelete you!

I won't let you delete our
world! Don't think you can
get away with doing
whatever you want!
We're not your toys!
No... How...? I'm your\nCreator... How is this\npossible...?

Oh, I know... All I have to
do is turn everything into
nothingness...
Bwahahahahaha! That's
right!
I'll just completely delete\nall the data.
There's no way you\nviruses will survive that.
This is bad! I've got a bad\nfeeling about this!
Luther! What do you think\nyou're doing!? Stop!
This is the end. And now\neverything will fade away.
Die! Die! Die! Die! Die! Die!\nDie! Die! Diiiiiie!!!
The world is disappearing.
Were we too late?
I believe... I believe we're\nright here, right now for a\nreason.
You're right. We're not just\nsome data that someone\nput together.
Yeah. We're not going to\ndisappear just because\nsomeone told us to!
That's right! We're not\ngoing anywhere!!!
If we just believe, I bet...
Huh? Coro, is your body\nstarting to fade?
No! What is happening!?\nAre we going to disappear\nafter all...?
Coro! Coro! What is this!? I\nthought we won...
...Captain? You'll catch a\ncold, sleeping in a place\nlike this.
Oh no, the world is fading\naway!
Eve, are you okay?
Where am I? ...Who am I?
The world is gone!? What\nare you talking about...?

I wish I could say you're
not making any sense, but
I clearly remember...the
feeling of my own
existence, fading away...
I never want to feel that\nsensation again...
But as you can see, I'm\njust fine. Coro and the\nothers are all okay, too.

Captain, I know you care
about everyone, but don't
you think you should
worry about yourself too,
every once in a while?
Huh...!? Amnesia...?
Knock it off with the weird\njokes! I was really scared\nthere for a moment.

Captain, if you lost your
memories, Coro would
have had to take
command of the ship.
Captain! You're awake! I\nwas so worried!

A world where you do not
wake up is not one worth
living in. But...the world is
still alive!
I had the same nightmare\njust now while in forced\nsleep mode.

How strange, for an AI to
have an indecipherable
dream. Maybe it is a bug
in my code?
Didn't you have something\nimportant to tell the\ncaptain, Coro?
What? Do not tell me you\nare confessing your love\nat a time like this!?
What!? No, that's not it...
Ah! I know!
Captain, great news! We\nare back in our original\ntime, along with our ship!

Earth is still far away, but
this is definitely the
universe you and I are
familiar with!
The events that occurred\ninside the black hole\nremain a mystery...
But we made it back alive,\nso let's not mind the\ndetails!

That was a long detour,
but we're finally back on
track again. Time to
resume our journey back
to Earth.
And so this story comes\nto a close.
A new event story will be\navailable at a later date.
